finite_descent_theorem.name: FINITE_GRAPH_STRICT_FRAME_DESCENT
equivalent_conditions: a global parallel frame family f_v exists
every closed-walk transport holonomy is identity
for one spanning tree, every fundamental-cycle holonomy is identity
finite_descent_theorem.construction_if_condition_holds: choose one seed frame at a root and transport it along the spanning tree; fundamental-cycle exactness makes all non-tree overlaps agree
finite_descent_theorem.necessity: edge transports telescope around every closed walk when T_uv=f_v o f_u^-1

enumeration.criterion_in_C2: even swap parity iff globally realizable
enumeration.gauge_note: the two realizations differ by one global diagonal C2 relabeling

minimality: with at most two probes there is no overlap cycle, so every inverse-consistent transport assignment integrates
on any tree, arbitrary edge bijections integrate from a seed frame
with one-state fibers the local automorphism group is trivial, so no twisting obstruction exists
therefore 3 probes + 3 overlaps + fiber cardinality 2 is minimal for this strict framed obstruction

p000_alignment.independent_connection_guard: independent nontrivial holonomy may exist; that obstructs synchronization into one parallel frame but not bare existence of a global object with connection
p000_alignment.minimal_new_axiom_if_strict_reconstructi: CYCLE_EXACTNESS: every fundamental-cycle transport is identity
p000_alignment.not_required: no topological cover, sheaf, stack, or higher object is required to state the first obstruction

classical_lens_after_obstruction.graph_language: edge transports are a group-valued 1-cochain; global frames are vertex potentials/coboundaries
classical_lens_after_obstruction.C2_triangle: the obstruction is the nonzero class in H^1(C3;C2), equivalently odd swap parity
classical_lens_after_obstruction.scope: comparison vocabulary only; the P000 axiom is derived as route-independence/cycle exactness rather than imported from classical topology
